ui.选择仓库并像使用网盘一样管理文件: Select a repository and manage it like a cloud drive
ui.启动程序后自动启动监听: Start listener when the application starts
ui.定期扫描本地变动并上传。增量备份创建时间戳目录；同路径覆盖会更新远端文件，但不会: Periodically scan and upload local changes. Incremental backups create timestamped folders; same-path updates overwrite matching remote files but do not delete extra remote files.
ui.填写后保存新的备份任务: Complete the fields and save the new backup task
ui.确定移除备份任务 {name}？远端和本地文件不会被删除。: Remove backup task {name}? Remote and local files will not be deleted.
ui.请等待当前备份任务完成。: Wait for the current backup task to finish.
ui.当前传输完成后再执行备份。: Run the backup after the current transfer finishes.
ui.目标账户或仓库当前不可用。: The destination account or repository is currently unavailable.
ui.备份完成：{uploaded} 个上传，{failed} 个失败，{skippe: Backup complete: {uploaded} uploaded, {failed} failed, {skipped} at least 50 GB skipped
ui.{count} 个文件达到或超过 50 GB，未上传。: {count} files are at least 50 GB and were not uploaded.
ui.本地备份文件夹不存在。: The local backup folder does not exist.
ui.目标目录中没有时间戳备份。: No timestamped backup exists in the destination folder.
ui.没有小于或等于 {limit:g} MB 的云端文件。: There are no cloud files at or below {limit:g} MB.
ui.已添加 {count} 个云端文件到下载队列: Added {count} cloud files to the download queue
ui.拖入图片后上传到指定仓库，生成直链并保存本地缓存。: Drop images to upload them to the selected repository, create direct links, and retain a local cache.
ui.支持 PNG、JPEG、WebP、GIF、AVIF、SVG 等常见格式: Supports PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, AVIF, SVG, and other common formats
ui.请等待当前图片上传完成。: Wait for the current image upload to finish.
ui.当前传输完成后再上传图片。: Upload images after the current transfer finishes.
ui.请选择支持的常见图片格式。: Select a supported common image format.
ui.请选择已经验证且可写入的账户仓库。: Select a verified account repository with write access.
ui.上传成功，最新图片直链已复制: Upload succeeded; the newest direct link was copied
ui.本地缓存已不存在，请重新上传或从仓库下载。: The local cache no longer exists. Upload again or download it from the repository.
ui.仅移除本地记录和缓存，远端文件不会删除。是否继续？: Only the local record and cache will be removed; the remote file remains. Continue?
ui.将本地文件或文件夹拖到下方任意目录，即可直接上传到该目录: Drop local files or folders onto any directory below to upload
ui.也可以使用下方按钮选择，可一次添加多个项目: Or select multiple items using the buttons below
ui.在资源管理页面右键文件或文件夹，可添加到此队列。: Right-click a file or folder in Resources to add it to this queue.
ui.Token 使用设备绑定加密；添加后会自动验证并取得用户名。: Tokens are encrypted for this device; adding one verifies and retrieves its username.
ui.输入新账户 Token 后保存并验证: Enter the new account token, then save and verify
ui.确定移除账户 {name}？本地保存的 Token 将被销毁。: Remove account {name}? Its locally saved token will be destroyed.
ui.用于验证账户、读取仓库以及访问私有资源。: Used to verify your account and access private resources.
ui.使用本地 PotPlayer 作为默认视频/图片播放器: Use locally installed PotPlayer as the default video/image player
ui.播放器不随程序预装。点击下载后将使用内置 aria2-next 获取并校验 Po: The player is not preinstalled. The app downloads and verifies PotPlayer.7z with bundled aria2-next, then extracts it locally with 7z-zstd.
ui.PotPlayer：下载未完成，点击按钮继续: PotPlayer: download incomplete; click the button to continue
ui.请等待当前解压安装完成。: Wait for the current extraction to finish.
ui.PotPlayer 将加入下载队列，并在当前下载完成后自动开始。: PotPlayer will be queued and will start after the current download finishes.
ui.播放器已经可以作为默认内置播放器使用。: The player is ready to use as the default built-in player.
ui.媒体右键菜单会在本地 PotPlayer 之后显示以下第三方播放器。: The media menu lists these third-party players after local PotPlayer.
ui.音视频右键菜单会按这里的顺序显示播放器名称。: The media context menu lists players in this order.
ui.按文件大小自动分配 HTTP 连接和下载分段，并为小文件仓库增加并行任务。: Automatically tune HTTP connections, splits, and parallel tasks by file size.
ui.提示：aria2-next 的最小分片为 1 MB；分段数是上限，较小文件会按实: Note: aria2-next has a 1 MB minimum piece size. Split counts are upper limits.
ui.0 表示不限速。分时时段按每天重复执行，跨越午夜的时段同样有效；多条重叠时以最后: Zero means unlimited. Scheduled periods repeat daily, may cross midnight, and the last overlapping rule wins.
ui.启动时完整更新一次；日常修改会等到空闲或程序进入后台后再更新。: Run one complete update at startup; daily changes wait for idle time or background operation.
ui.使用 WebDAV 网关。受到 ModelScope 官方 API 限制，不支持: Uses a WebDAV gateway. ModelScope API limitations prevent delete, rename, move, and copy operations.
ui.AList 后台添加存储：驱动选择 WebDAV，厂商选择“其他”，地址填写上方: In AList, add a WebDAV storage, choose vendor Other, enter the URL above, and set the root folder to / or leave it blank. Docker can use host.docker.internal. Other devices require LAN / Docker listening; if the connection still times out, allow this application through Windows Defender Firewall.
ui.输入他人的公开数据集或模型链接，无需登录即可浏览和下载。: Enter a public ModelScope dataset or model URL to browse and download without signing in.
ui.等待输入公开资源链接: Waiting for a public resource URL
ui.PotPlayer 尚未安装或启动失败。: PotPlayer is not installed or could not be started.
ui.检测到设备变化，已销毁已保存的访问令牌: Device change detected. The saved access token was destroyed.
ui.当前有任务在进行，是否终止所有任务并关闭？: A transfer is active. Stop all tasks and exit?
ui.关闭程序，还是最小化到通知区域？: Exit the application or minimize it to the notification area?
ui.程序仍在通知区域运行，传输任务不会中断。: The application is still running in the notification area. Transfers will continue.
ui.WebDAV 用户名和密码不能为空。: WebDAV username and password cannot be empty.
ui.已读取 {count} 个仓库，请选择一个仓库: Loaded {count} repositories. Select one to continue.
ui.上传完成，目录将在空闲时自动刷新: Upload complete; the directory will refresh when idle
ui.尚未设置并验证 ModelScope 访问令牌。是否转到设置？: No verified ModelScope token is configured. Open Settings?
ui.外部播放器无法安全接收 ModelScope 访问令牌。请先下载该文件，再从本地: An external player cannot receive the ModelScope token securely. Download the file before playing it.
ui.播放器未能启动，请重新选择播放器程序。: The player did not start. Select the executable again.
ui.当前操作完成后再加载公开资源。: Load the public resource after the current operation finishes.
ui.请先在左侧选择目标仓库。: Select the target repository on the left first.
ui.已有任务正在运行，请完成后再拖放上传。: Another task is running. Wait for it to finish before dropping files.
ui.请先在设置中选择默认下载路径。: Choose a default download folder in Settings first.
ui.所选目录中没有可下载的文件。: The selected folder contains no downloadable files.
ui.模型仓库 API 不支持单个超过 50 GB 的文件。以下文件不会上传：\n\n: The model repository API does not accept individual files over 50 GB. These files will not be uploaded:
ui.{ok} 个项目上传成功，{failed} 个失败。\n请在操作记录中查看详情。:
{ok} items uploaded and {failed} failed.
See the activity log for details.
